changesApplied.changeMade: Added try-catch wrapper around JSON.parse with descriptive error message including raw JSON excerpt
changesApplied.reason: Prevents compose-first workflow crashes from malformed LLM responses. Hierarchical composition requires resilient parsing since LLM output drives activity composition decisions.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects error handling path. No behavior change on valid JSON. Improves reliability of goal decomposition which is critical entry point for hierarchical composition.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added safeStringify() helper with circular reference detection using WeakSet, replaced JSON.stringify calls at lines 471 and 479
changesApplied.reason: Enables activities-as-impulses pattern for complex activity state. Circular references can occur in hierarchical compositions where parent activities reference child outputs. This ensures data flow doesn't crash on realistic scenarios.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium blast radius - affects all activityOutput impulse resolution. Backward compatible (only changes error case). Critical for hierarchical composition reliability since activities are injected as impulses into parent workflows.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added retryWithBackoff() helper function with exponential backoff (3 attempts, base 1000ms delay). Updated save() to use retry wrapper for MCP registration.
changesApplied.reason: Ensures transient network failures don't permanently lose templates. Backend-only architecture requires reliable MCP communication for hierarchical composition to scale. Retry logic maintains template availability for future composition.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects template registration error handling. Adds ~6 second delay on persistent failures (1s + 2s + 4s backoff). No behavior change on success. Critical for production reliability of compose-first workflow.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added semantic validation: goalDescription max 10000 chars, templateName max 200 chars, variables must be JSON-serializable. All with descriptive error messages.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents DoS attacks and ensures activities-as-impulses pattern works. Unbounded input can crash LLM context, non-serializable variables break impulse injection. Validation enforces quality gates for hierarchical composition.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - validation happens before workflow starts. Fail-fast on invalid input prevents wasted compute and downstream failures. Improves reliability of compose-first entry point.
